name: Job Opportunity Scout
description: Find open roles that match a candidate's skills, level, location, and compensation needs.
targetEntity: An actively hiring company with a relevant open role

criteria.label: Role fit
criteria.description: The role matches the target function and responsibilities.

criteria.label: Skill fit
criteria.description: The required skills substantially match the candidate's capabilities.

criteria.label: Seniority fit
criteria.description: The role's experience expectations match the candidate.

criteria.label: Compensation fit
criteria.description: Published or credible compensation meets the configured floor.

criteria.label: Location fit
criteria.description: Location, remote policy, and working hours are compatible.

signals.label: Verified open role
signals.description: The role is present on an official or current hiring source.

signals.label: Referral path
signals.description: A relevant employee or direct hiring contact is identifiable.

disqualifiers.label: Work authorization mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The role requires unavailable work authorization.

disqualifiers.label: Compensation below floor
disqualifiers.description: Confirmed compensation is below the configured minimum.

disqualifiers.label: Seniority mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The role is clearly outside the target seniority.
